items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Myra Menville do you remember any official position she had? [INTERVIEWEE] well I think she was secretary of New Orleans Jazz Club

ctx.x: sure there are pictures I've seen of that band there

with Elton Pernell and Joe Watkins and Drag and Lawrence and Jim who at one point was out and Waldron Joseph called Frog came in but that was very brief maybe a couple of weeks or something a substitute maybe a couple of nights I don't know okay let's see now Myra Menville do you remember any official position she had?
well I think she was secretary of New Orleans Jazz Club

items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: I remember Myra Menville, Johnny Wiggs, that's where I first met Johnny.

ctx.x: city owned at the time. That comes back to me now. I totally forgot.

And I don't remember anything about it beyond that, except it was a kind of an organizational meeting, much like dozens of other organizational meetings I've been to since. But apparently it took that time, and I remember Myra Menville, Johnny Wiggs, that's where I first met Johnny. Freddie King. Those are about the only people I remember offhand. I remember meetings in the St. Charles Hotel on Sunday afternoons later on, at which there was some music, which was usually not all that great as far as I was…

items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-07-31
items.q: Interviewer mentions Myra Menville in context of bands auditioning, Interviewee responds 'I don't, no, I don't think it was one of them.'

ctx.x: I don't think that was an audition. I think that was a party.

Yeah, yeah. Oh, yeah. But I think that he held an audition at the record shop. It did Emil Barnes for his band for, and this was, I remember the Emil Barnes, and it was just before Christmas, because Ralph St. LaProffitt came in. And it was the very night he was leaving for New York. And on his holiday, he was a visiting lecturer, visiting artist, rather, at LSU. He was about to take off, and so it would have made, I'd say December 20th or something like that. And Myra was there to hear the band, and also was…
